mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.nickname, c.username, c.email, c.phone, c.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, c.role_tag AS roleTag, c.status, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_order o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS orderCount FROM customer c

where.if: AND ( c.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(c.id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
